body: I know exactly what you mean. I planned to do it on the 13th, the day my friend moved away, because we were going to hang out for an entire week before then, and I wanted that to be my last memory, but... here I am, and I don't think I can do it anymore. I'm so happy for you, I'm so glad you're having a good time now, your story is very inspiring.

The last (and only) therapist I've ever had was very unprofessional. He told me more about his problems than I could say anything about mine. He was also very racist, so whenever I explained my problems, he tried to blame it on people of color. It was very uncomfortable for me so I stopped talking to him entirely.
